name: Le Loi
role: Leader of the Lam Sơn uprising and founding emperor (Lê Thái Tổ)
known_facts: Launched the Lam Sơn uprising in 1418 from the mountains of Thanh Hóa
Expelled the Ming occupation and restored Đại Việt independence
Founded the Later Lê dynasty in 1428
Aided by the strategist and diplomat Nguyễn Trãi
interpretation: Early-15th-century Đại Việt commander and Lam Sơn resistance dress, based on the user reference.
unknowns: No verified contemporary life portrait survives
